reasons: F05, F06: auditor change within two years combined with a disclosed disagreement with the accountants is a rare and serious red flag suggesting dispute over accounting treatment
F01, F02, F03: material weakness in financial close/reporting, with no ICFR auditor attestation (smaller filer), means controls over the reported numbers are known to be deficient and unaudited
F11, F12, F13: material related-party transactions and heavy customer concentration (25-50% of revenue) create scope for non-arm's-length or circular revenue
F14, F20: management turnover in the year plus incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS adds pressure and opportunity
R04, R09, R15, F22: very high sales growth (>40%) partly from an acquisition, with Beneish M-score above -1.78 and rising ROA, consistent with possible earnings manipulation
R19: operating cash flow well below net income (<0.8x) indicates earnings not backed by cash, although R08 shows negative total accruals, which tempers this somewhat
R03, R13, F22: high asset quality index and soft assets >75% of total assets (likely goodwill/intangibles from acquisition) suggest capitalisation or valuation judgments at risk
R02, R07, R16, F21: sharply declining gross margin, rising leverage and capital raising create financing pressure to present favourable results
F04, F07, F16, F17, F18, R17: no going concern doubt, no restatement, no investigations or class actions and Dechow F-score below threshold are mild mitigating factors
